pages.title: Harlan's Ground Sloth
pages.text: Harlan's ground sloth ($(o)Paramylodon harlani$()) lived across North America, from Washington State to Mexico, during the Pleistocene.$(br2)It weighed over a tonne, with a long, broad-fronted snout, big claws for digging and a thick tail. Its hide was studded with small, pebble-like bones.$(br2)Fossil footprints it left at Carson City, Nevada, were at first claimed to be the tracks of giant humans. It died out about 12,000 years ago.
